title: State Schedule: Garaging State Loading on the Switch Down Payment — Installment Payment Plans
content:
**Company's own state schedule (no statute sets it).** Under the **Installment Payment Plans**, when a plan billing an Owner Auto Policy term is moved off automatic draft to the Cardinal Point Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan, percentage points are added to the switch down payment percentage by the state in which the Owner Auto Policy term is garaged:

| Garaging state of the Owner Auto Policy term | Added to the switch down payment percentage |
|---|---|
| Florida | 2.5 |
| Georgia | 1.5 |
| Texas | 1.5 |
| Virginia | nothing |
| Ohio | nothing |
| Arizona | nothing |

The garaging state is read from the Owner Auto Policy term the plan bills.
